job: Show one conversation growing from a simple exchange into a useful household checklist, without suggesting guaranteed correctness, safety or unattended control.
scene: People-free adult home desk. A tablet shows one continuous blank conversation path that begins with two simple empty chat bubbles and leads visually to an editable checklist card. Three distinct appliance manuals sit beside the tablet with a pencil and small desk lamp.
mustShow: One continuous conversation, not two mode panels
Checklist card with blank ruled lines only
mustNotShow: Readable text, letters, numbers or pseudo-text
Checkmarks, approval badges, shields or padlocks
Workplace report, presentation deck or provider example

style.palette: Navy/plum linework with cyan, pink, coral and yellow electric accents.
style.finish: Crisp adult editorial pop-art, meaningful object action, halftone print texture, clean negative space; no glossy tech-ad look.

output.alt: An illustrated tablet beside appliance manuals shows one blank conversation leading to a checklist.
